beschreibung: Borussia Mönchengladbach boss praises two heroes of Bundesliga comeback victory – Borussia Mönchengladbach Head of Sport Rouven Schröder expressed relief after Friday's dramatic 3-2 comeback victory over VfB Stuttgart ended a six-match losing streak. The 51-year-old praised matchwinners Wael Mohya and Joe Scally.
